historic_survey.note: A Modernist office tower added behind the 1906-08 Bank of California by Anshen & Allen, its concrete spandrels echoing the fluting of the older bank's columns. Cited as an early example of a sensitive Modernist addition to a historic building.

unknowns: The statement dates this tower 1967 on p. 9 and 1968 on p. 57.
